title: luaut project configuration
description: Applies to every .luaut file in this folder and the folders below it, unless a nearer luaut.config.json takes over.

types.description: Type libraries to load. Nothing is built in — not even `print` — so list what the project uses. A name is looked up as @luaut/<name>, then as a package of that name; a full package name or a relative path works too.

paths.description: Import path aliases, as in tsconfig. A pattern may contain one `*`; targets resolve from baseUrl.

baseUrl.description: Where `paths` targets resolve from. Defaults to this config's folder.

sourceMap.description: A Rojo sourcemap (`rojo sourcemap -o sourcemap.json`). When set, `game`, `workspace` and each file's `script` are typed from the real instance tree. null for none.
